The space

A calm, modern two-bed with a view worth waking up to

Set on a high floor with floor-to-ceiling windows, the apartment opens onto a private balcony looking out over the city skyline. Inside, an open-plan living and kitchen area, two proper double bedrooms, and a full bathroom — all finished in soft neutrals with warm olive accents.

It's set up the way I'd want a place to feel if I were the one arriving after a long journey: comfortable bed linen, a fully equipped kitchen so you're not stuck ordering in every night, and fast wifi if you need to get work done.
